description: This file is a PHPUnit test class that tests the behavior of the ClassHelper class within the OrangeHRM project. It includes test methods for class name resolution, class existence verification, and interface implementation checks.

classes.name: ClassHelperTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the ClassHelper utility class, covering class name resolution, existence, and interface implementation checks.

classes.name: ClassHelperTestClass
classes.description: A stub class used for testing class name resolution.

classes.name: ClassHelperTestInterfaceOne
classes.description: A stub interface used for testing interface implementation checks.

classes.name: ClassHelperTestInterfaceTwo
classes.description: A stub interface used for testing multiple interface implementation checks.

classes.name: ClassHelperTestClassTwo

methods.name: testGetClass
methods.description: Tests the getClass method of ClassHelper for generating full class names based on provided class names and optional namespace prefixes.

methods.name: testClassExists
methods.description: Verifies the classExists method's ability to correctly identify existing and non-existing classes within given namespaces.

methods.name: testHasClassImplements
methods.description: Checks whether the hasClassImplements method correctly determines if a class or object implements specified interfaces.
